contract: Opaque unlit colors are composited at original vertices, then piecewise-affinely interpolated. Internal triangle edges remain in all metrics. No scalar remapping.
negativeControls: LegacyTriangle under patched ES2 must fail diagonal-edge color criterion
AdaptiveAffineOpaque under stock ES2 must fail dense ramp criterion
oracle: Clip original colored triangles to each pixel square; bound colors using the affine function at intersection vertices, independent of atlas/native UVs. Gate all fully covered pixel footprints and report interior/edge populations separately. Partial outer silhouettes are excluded because background coverage is not specified. For AA off additionally compare pixel-center barycentric color.
toleranceRationale: Prospective 8-bit integration budget for texel quantization, hardware bilinear interpolation and framebuffer rounding. This is an empirical acceptance threshold, not a theorem about every JavaFX/driver implementation.
permutationChecks: Compare pixels for semantic-equivalent cyclic/packing orders, using the same 2-channel-level budget; retain failures separately.
limitations: macOS ES2 and exact runtime only
pixel-footprint bounds are conservative, not an exact multisample color oracle
no lighting, actual device scale, nonlinear/scalar lookup semantics, cortical occlusion or interactive ray picks
